mappingPolicy: Primary owner follows the actual Conation product/screen. Dedicated Conation AUTH/DELIVERY/E2E/SHARE cards own their stated scope; cross-product issues are primary only for screen scope they explicitly state. Where no dedicated applicable Conation screen owner exists, CONATION-E2E-01 retains the exact screen acceptance row with per-screen delegation metadata. No issue arrays or source acceptance text are changed.

delegation.screen: Home, Dashboard, CRM, Reminders, Settings, navigation shortcut
